# Vendored libraries

Third-party code the app ships with, copied verbatim from npm and pinned. Never edit
these files — replace them whole with another exact version (see CLAUDE.md).

| folder | package | version | licence | file | used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `html-to-image/` | html-to-image | 1.11.13 | MIT | `dist/html-to-image.js` (UMD) | drawing the phone to a canvas for web exports |
| `fflate/` | fflate | 0.8.3 | MIT | `umd/index.js` | project-file zips (sync API only — no workers) |
| `webm-muxer/` | webm-muxer | 5.1.4 | MIT | `build/webm-muxer.js` (IIFE) | the WebM container for web video export |
| `daisyui/` | daisyui | 5.7.47 | MIT | **generated** `daisyui.css` | the editor's buttons, fields, toggles, tabs and dialogs |

`daisyui/daisyui.css` is the one exception to "copied verbatim": it is generated by
`npm run build:ui-css` from `scripts/ui-css/daisyui.src.css` (Tailwind CSS 4.3.3 + daisyUI
5.7.47, both pinned dev dependencies), so that every class has a `d-` prefix, only the
classes the editor uses are included, and the only theme is our own. Never edit it by
hand — change the source file and regenerate. It is used by the editor only; the phone
mockups and the desktop export window never load it.

Emoji (`../emoji/`, built by `scripts/build-emoji.mjs`, never edited by hand):
- `emojione/` — EmojiOne 2.2.7 artwork from the `emojione@2.2.7` npm package
  (`assets/svg`), copied unchanged. **CC BY 4.0** (credit required: the picker shows
  "Emoji art: EmojiOne, CC BY 4.0"; licence text in `emojione/LICENSE.txt`).
- `possum/` — the possum faces, art by possummachine (the picker credits them:
  "Possum faces: art by possummachine"), shrunk to 128 px PNG. Kept by the owner's
  choice for this free app.
- `../js/core/emojidata.js` — the index the app reads (file names, picker tabs).

Fonts (`../fonts/`): `@fontsource/inter` and `@fontsource/roboto` 5.3.0, latin subset
woff2 only, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (licence files beside them).

None of them uses `eval`, `new Function` or WebAssembly, so the strict
`script-src 'self'` policy holds.
